definition.external_forward: An exported PE forwarder whose target is an o_*.dll.
definition.internal_original_call: A locally exported function that still loads or calls an o_*.dll at runtime.
definition.standalone: The DLL has no known direct or internal dependency on an original ShadowFlare DLL.
definition.fidelity: Status is conservative: unverified and partial code is never counted as faithful.

RK_FUNCTION.notes: The real table payload has exact decode and byte-for-byte encode parity. String, path, SJIS-index, message, time, and LZ file/memory APIs are differentially covered; unused Huffman, picker, and bit-writer exports remain.

RKC_FILE.notes: Constructor, I/O, seeking, size, close, and destructor handle ownership match the original probe.

RKC_MEMORY.notes: Allocation, initialization, copy, ranged clear, release, and zero-size behavior match the original probe.

RKC_WINDOW.notes: Object layout, constructor initialization, and full assignment match the original probe; window operations were reconstructed from decompilation.

RKC_DIB.notes: Core bitmap operations, odd-width conversion behavior, and the complete 1.15 MB high-speed table match differential probes; the broader drawing matrix still needs coverage.

RKC_DSOUND.notes: Uses the replacement LAL backend; timing, looping, volume, and VOC behavior require differential validation.

RKC_FONTMAKER.notes: Construction, assignment, DIB palette setup, glyph rasterization, and the complete 65-atlas NJP writer have exact differential hashes and byte-for-byte file parity.

RKC_RPG_TABLE.notes: The real compressed Table.Tbd produces the same 138 tables, 55,550 cells, 530 string cells, and canonical content hash as the original.

RKC_UPDIB.notes: All paths are local. NJP and SDW versions 2 and 3, compressed and uncompressed parts, palettes, patterns, lists, names, judgement data, direct DIB rendering, and sprite rendering match retail probes on real game assets.

RKC_DBFCONTROL.notes: Object behavior is differentially covered. Initialization, windowed/OpenGL and fullscreen/DirectDraw presentation, timing, and draw threads are local; the game reaches and sustains its render loop under Wine.

RKC_RPGSCRN.notes: All exports are local. Object/display/animation/ground ownership and accessors, sorting, packet routing, CAF parsing, real 79-object OBL parsing, and real compressed 85x80 GND parsing match retail probes. Broader in-game map and rendering combinations still need coverage.

RKC_RPG_SCRIPT.notes: The retail binary codec, object layouts, list operations, and runtime getters are local. A real Scenario.Scs has exact semantic and byte-for-byte writeback parity; the unused text-script compiler remains unimplemented.

RKC_RPG_AICONTROL.notes: All list, event, and action operations are local. The real 91,936-byte Control.aid produces exact list/action semantics and an exact byte-for-byte writeback.

RKC_NETWORK.notes: All exports are local. Packet and user containers, manager/client/server lifecycle, connection queues, transfer framing, socket threads, and a live localhost request/response exchange match the retail DLL. Authenticated multiplayer and failure timing still need broader validation.
